name: Gas Town
description: Coordinates 20 to 30 coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot across git repos, keeping work state in git-backed hooks and a Beads issue ledger.

skills.name: Mayor Coordinator
skills.description: Runs a Mayor agent with full workspace context that turns your request into convoys of beads and slings them to worker agents.

skills.name: Persistent Work Hooks
skills.description: Stores each agent's work in git worktree hooks and a Beads ledger, so work survives crashes, restarts, and ended sessions.

skills.name: Watchdog Recovery
skills.description: Monitors agents with per-rig Witnesses and a patrolling Deacon that detect stuck work, trigger recovery, and escalate blockers.

skills.name: Refinery Merge Queue
skills.description: Batches finished work into a Bors-style bisecting merge queue that runs verification gates and isolates failing merge requests.

skills.name: Formula Workflows
skills.description: Defines repeatable multi-step processes as TOML formulas and runs them as tracked molecules with checkpointed steps.
